card.name: Small words in engineering design descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words, such as to, for, and, a comma or low, right after adjectives like light, compact, low-cost or impossible in technical descriptions of devices. They come where a purpose or capability is about to be stated.

modes.label: Purpose link after size or cost
modes.description: Words like to, for, allow or low that follow compact, lightweight or low-cost hardware descriptions.
modes.example: must be compact and lightweight<< to>> allow for a larger scientific payload

modes.label: Link inside a capability phrase
modes.description: A joining word or verb inside a phrase about what a system can or cannot do.
modes.example: making it impossible<< to>> process scenes containing very dark and very bright

modes.description: A comma or and joining descriptive terms for a vehicle or animal.
